self_reported_defect.what: My first P2 implementation recomputed the parser identity from the EXECUTING function at both derivation and verification. That catches evidence derived under a DIFFERENT parser, but a substituted parser is self-consistent for NEW evidence — it signs its own forgery. The acceptance probe caught it: case 1b did not raise.
self_reported_defect.fix: SEALED_PARSER_IDENTITIES — the expected identity of each allowlisted parser is a COMMITTED constant. resolve_parser refuses when the executing source does not hash to the sealed value, so both a substitution and an unreviewed legitimate edit are refused until the constant is deliberately updated in review. Same discipline as the executable allowlist of the dispatch driver.
self_reported_defect.disclosure: Reported unprompted; the failing probe output is preserved in this file's provenance.
